activities.instructions: Desliza a la derecha si la frase es correcta y a la izquierda si no lo es.
activities.prompt: Mazo de 5 afirmaciones para repasar el tema.

cards.statement: You can spend time shopping as well as spend money on clothes.
cards.explanation: Spend se usa tanto con dinero como con tiempo.

cards.statement: The receipt shows what you bought and paid for.
cards.explanation: Receipt es el recibo de la compra.

cards.statement: The sentence I spent £30 on a jumper is grammatically natural.
cards.explanation: Spend + cantidad + on + objeto es correcto.

cards.statement: Could you borrow me your jacket?
cards.explanation: Se dice Could you lend me your jacket? Borrow es recibir, lend es prestar.

activities.explanation: Cada carta repasa una regla del tema; revisa las falladas al terminar el mazo.

cards.statement: The jacket is on sale, so it is currently reduced in price.
cards.explanation: On sale normalmente indica una rebaja.
La colocación enseñada es spent £10 on a belt.

cards.statement: If a coat is worth the price, it offers value for what you pay.
cards.explanation: Worth the price relaciona valor y coste.

cards.statement: What is the price of this coat?
cards.explanation: Price es la cantidad que cuesta algo.

cards.statement: Borrow means give something to another person temporarily.
cards.explanation: Borrow es recibir; lend es dar algo temporalmente.
Suit describe que una prenda favorece a alguien.

cards.statement: A discount makes the original price higher.
cards.explanation: A discount reduce el precio original.

cards.statement: The shop offered a refund for the faulty product.
cards.explanation: Refund es la devolución del dinero.
Spend money on + producto es correcto.
Cost puede llevar a la persona: The shoes cost me £50.

cards.statement: You can ask for an exchange when you want a different size of the same item.
cards.explanation: An exchange permite cambiar un producto por otro.

cards.statement: Can I try on this jumper?
cards.explanation: Try on significa probarse una prenda.

cards.statement: If you can afford a watch, you are unable to pay for it.
cards.explanation: Can afford significa que sí puedes pagarlo.
